question: Find orders for which the sum of line-item discounted prices differs from the recorded order total price.
gold_sql: SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_totalprice, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS line_item_total FROM orders AS o JOIN lineitem AS l ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_totalprice HAVING ABS(SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) - o.o_totalprice) > 0.01 ORDER BY o.o_orderkey
pred_sql:
WITH order_calc AS (
    SELECT
        l_orderkey,
        SUM(CAST(l_extendedprice AS REAL) * (1 - CAST(l_discount AS REAL))) AS calc_total
    FROM lineitem
    GROUP BY l_orderkey
)
SELECT
    o.o_orderkey,
    CAST(o.o_totalprice AS REAL) AS recorded_total,
    oc.calc_total AS calculated_total,
    CAST(o.o_totalprice AS REAL) - oc.calc_total AS difference
FROM orders AS o
JOIN order_calc AS oc ON o.o_orderkey = oc.l_orderkey
WHERE ABS(CAST(o.o_totalprice AS REAL) - oc.calc_total) > 0.01

question: For each region, calculate the total profit as discounted line-item revenue minus supply cost multiplied by quantity.
gold_sql: SELECT r.r_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount) - ps.ps_supplycost * l.l_quantity) AS total_profit FROM lineitem AS l JOIN partsupp AS ps ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey AND ps.ps_suppkey = l.l_suppkey JOIN supplier AS s ON s.s_suppkey = l.l_suppkey JOIN nation AS n ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN region AS r ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey GROUP BY r.r_regionkey, r.r_name ORDER BY total_profit DESC
pred_sql:
WITH profit_calc AS (
    SELECT
        r.r_name AS region,
        SUM(CAST(l.l_extendedprice AS REAL) * (1 - CAST(l.l_discount AS REAL)) - CAST(ps.ps_supplycost AS REAL) * CAST(l.l_quantity AS REAL)) AS total_profit
    FROM lineitem AS l
    JOIN orders AS o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey
    JOIN customer AS c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey
    JOIN nation AS n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey
    JOIN region AS r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey
    JOIN partsupp AS ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey AND l.l_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey
    GROUP BY r.r_name
)
SELECT region, total_profit
FROM profit_calc
ORDER BY region
